description: Local-first application firewall and real-time network monitor with per-process traffic attribution, connection history, and IP threat intelligence.
notes: Verified with KiroBucket's NSIS extraction workflow: Scoop extracts the official installer through #/dl.7z, then pre_install extracts the nested $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z payload. The inner archive contains Snitch.exe at its root, resources/app.asar, resources/frontend_dist, and resources/snitch-backend/snitch-backend.exe. The vendor NSIS installation routine is not executed.
Npcap is not bundled. Install Npcap separately for live packet capture; this manifest does not install its driver.
Snitch stores its database, settings, and logs under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Snitch. Scoop does not relocate or remove this user data.

The built-in updater is enabled by default, checks periodically, downloads updates, and can install them when Snitch exits. Disable update checks in Snitch Settings or set SNITCH_NO_UPDATE=1 to keep updates under Scoop control.
